Bwainakim Irou e rangi ni korakora, e aki kona ni mwanuokinaki. Au bwai n tituaraoi nakoim e rangi n takaburinako, e aki kona n rabunaki. Au tangira e a tia ni karaoa mwengana i nanom, e aki kona ni karabaaki. Otau e kaotaki nakoim, e aki kona n tukaki.
entries.label: Arabic HW 20

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 21
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

I aon te kai ae e raneanea mimitongina I a tia ni katinei i bukim taian uaanikai aika a bane n rianako tamaroaia, e aera ngkai ko a tannako mai iai ao ko ni karauakiko ma ake a rinano riki aroia? Oki rikaaki ngkanne nakon are e tamaroa riki i bukim i nanon te abanuea are i eta.
entries.label: Arabic HW 21

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 22
entries.text:
O NATIN TE TAMNEI!

I a tia ni karikiko n kakannangaki, e ngae n anne ko uotiko rikaaki ni kamaemaeko. Teirake ngkanne nakon are ko karikaki i bukina.
entries.label: Arabic HW 22

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 23
entries.text:
O NATIN AE E RIETAATA!

I weteiko nakon ae akea tokina, e ngae n anne ko ukoukora are e kakai mate. Tera ae e karikiko bwa ko na katannakoko man Nanora are Ti tangiria ao n ukoukora nanom are ko tangiria?
entries.label: Arabic HW 23

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 24
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Tai riaon are katauam, ke ni kan bwaina te bwai are e aki tau i bukim. Aroriko i matan Moamoan Atuam, Uean te mwaaka ao te korakora.
entries.label: Arabic HW 24

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 25
entries.text:
O NATIN TE TAMNEI!

Tai kamoamoako i aon are e kainnano, bwa I kaiririia i aon kawaina ao I nooria i nanon am mwakuri n riaboro nakoina ao ni kabwakako man nnem n aki tootoki.
entries.label: Arabic HW 25

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 26
entries.text:
O NATIN AE E MAIU!

Ko kanga ni kona ni mwaninga oin am kaairua ao ko katabeko ma aia kaairua tabeman? Ane e karaoa aei e na kamaraiaaki Irou.
entries.label: Arabic HW 26

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 27
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Tai ikeiken aia bure tabemwaang ngkai ko teimatoa n riki bwa te tia bure naba ngkoe. Ngkana ko riaon te tua aei, ko na maraia, n aei I kaotia ma te koaua.
entries.label: Arabic HW 27

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 28
entries.text:
O NATIN TE TAMNEI!

Ko na ataia te koaua; Teuare e tuangiia aomata bwa a na motiraoi ao ngaia e karaoa te motibuaka bon tiaki mai Irou, e ngae ngke e uota Arau.
entries.label: Arabic HW 28

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 29
entries.text:
O NATIN AE E MAIU!

Tai bukina temanna n te bwai are ko bon aki kan bukinaki iai, ao tai taekina te bwai are ko aki kan karaoia. Aio Au tua nakoim, ko na ongotaeka nako iai.
entries.label: Arabic HW 29

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 30
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Tai rawa n anga nakon Au toro ngkana e butiiko te bwai teuana, bwa moamoana bon Moau; ko na bwainrang i Matau.
entries.label: Arabic HW 30

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 31
entries.text:
O NATIN AE MAIU!

Tau mwiin aroarom n te bong ae e koraki imwaain teweam nakon te motikitaeka; bwa te mate, ae e roko ni kakubako, e na roko nakoim ao ko na weteaki bwa ko na kaotii bukin nako mwin am mwakuri.
entries.label: Arabic HW 31

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 32
entries.text:
O NATIN AE RIETAATA!

I a tia ni karaoa te mate bwa te tia uarongorongo ae e kakukurei nakoim. E aera ngkai ko a kananokaawakiko? I karaoa te oota bwa e na ruoniko tamaroana. Bukin tera ngkai ko a rabuniko mai iai?
entries.label: Arabic HW 32

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 33
entries.text:
O NATIN TE TAMNEI!

Ma rongorongon te oota ae e kakukurei i butimwaiko ma n taku: Kimwareirei! Nakon nanoaan Oou ae e tabu, I anoiko; teimatoa n tiku iai bwa ko aonga ni maeka i nanon te rau n aki toki.
entries.label: Arabic HW 33

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 34
entries.text:
O NATIN TE TAMNEI!

Tamnein ae e tabu e uota nakoim te rongorongo ae e kakukurei i bukin te manga kaitiboaki; e aera ngkai ko nanokaawaki? Tamnein te korakora e kamatoako inanon Ana waaki; e aera ngkai ko a rabuniko? Ootan Moamoana e kaririko; ko na kanga ngkanne ni bua nako?
entries.label: Arabic HW 34

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 35
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Tai nanokaawaki ma ti ngkana ko raroa nako Mai Iroura. Tai kimwareirei ma ti ngkana ko a tabe ni kaniiko ao n Okiriira.
entries.label: Arabic HW 35

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 36
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Kimwareirei i nanon kukurein nanom, bwa ko aonga n tau ni kaitibo ma Ngai ao ni kaotaa nako Tamaroau.
entries.label: Arabic HW 36

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 37
entries.text:
NATIN TE AOMATA O!

Tai buuta mai i aom Au kamwarai ae e tamaroa, ao tai kakeaa tibwangam man Au koburake n ran ae e kamiimi, bwa ko rawa n taka n aki toki.
entries.label: Arabic HW 37

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 38
entries.text:
O NATIN AE MAIU!

Nakonako inanon Au tua i bukin Tangirau ao tai karekea nakoim te bwai are ko tangiria ngkana ko ukoukora Kakukureiau.
entries.label: Arabic HW 38

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 39
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Tai kaaki taekan Au tua ngkana ko tangira Tamaroau, ao tai mwaninga taekan Au reirei ngkana ko kan karekea Kukureiu ae e raoiroi.
entries.label: Arabic HW 39

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 40
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

E ngae ngkana ko kabutimwaakako ribuakon buburakaein te tibeiti ao n tia naba ni kabuta rababan karawa, ma e na bon aki reke naba motirawam ma ti n te ongotaeka nakon Ara tua ao te kamangori i Matara.
entries.label: Arabic HW 40

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 41
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Katanoataa Au Waaki bwa I aonga ni kaota nakoim miterion Kakannatou ao ni kaotaa nako aom otan te aki totoki.
entries.label: Arabic HW 41

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 42
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Kamangoriko i Matau, bwa I aonga n akoiko ni kawariko. Teirake ibukin tokanikain Au Waaki, bwa ngkai ko bon mena i aon te aba ko na kona ni karekea te tokanikai.
entries.label: Arabic HW 42

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 43
entries.text:
O NATIN AE E MAIU!

Mwaneweai i aon Au aonaaba, bwa I aonga n Uringko i nanon Au karawa, bwa aonga ni karauaki Matau ma matam.
entries.label: Arabic HW 43

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 44
entries.text:
O NATIN TE KAINTOKANUEA!

Am kakauongo bon Au kakauongo, kakauongo mai iai. Am taratara bon Au taratara, taratara ngkanne mai iai, bwa i nanon kabin tamneim ko na kona ni kakoaua nakon rietaatan Arou ae e tabu, ao Ngai i Nanou Nna kona ni kakoaua nakon rietaatan te karinan i bukim.
entries.label: Arabic HW 44

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 45
entries.text:
O NATIN AE MAIU!

Ukoukora te mate ni maritire inanon Kawaiu, n rauaki ni Kukureiu ao n rangi ni karabwarabwa i bukin are I a tia ni baaireia, bwa ko aonga ni motirawa ma Ngai i aan nuun te kakannato ni uea i akuun te umwanrianna ae e mimitong.
entries.label: Arabic HW 45

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 46
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Iangoia ao rinanoia. Bon nanom ae ko tangiria bwa ko na mate i aon am kainiwene, ke ni katuua raraan maium i aontano, ni maritire i nanon Kawaiu, ao n riki bwa te tia kaotioti i bukin Au tua ao te tia katereterea Otau i aon rietan te Bwaretaiti? Karaoa am motikitaeka ae eti, O te toro!
entries.label: Arabic HW 46

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 47
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

N Tamaroau! Ni kabira iran atuum n raraam e rangi ni korakora riki i Matau nakon karikan te uniweeti ao ootan aonaaba aika uoua. Kekeiaki ngkanne ni karekea aio, O te toro!
entries.label: Arabic HW 47

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 48
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

I bukin bwaai nikabane bon iai te kanikina. Kanikinaean te tangira bon te nanomwaaka i aan Au moti ao te taotaonakinnano i aan Au kataitai.
entries.label: Arabic HW 48

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 49
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Te tia tangira ni koaua e ingainga nanona nakon te kanganga n ai aron te tia aki ongotaeka ibukin kabwaraan ana bure ao te tia burerawawata i bukin nanoangaeakina.
entries.label: Arabic HW 49

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 50
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Ngkana e aki bwakariko te karawawata inanon Kawaiu, ko na kanga n nakonako ni kawaiia naake a rauaki ni Kukureiu? Ngkana a aki rootiko kataitai inanon ingaingam ni kan kaaitiboo ma Ngai, ko na kanga ni karekea te oota n am tangira ibukin Tamaroau?
entries.label: Arabic HW 50

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 51
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Au kabuanibwai ae e korakora bon Au kamanomano, tinanikuna bon te ai ao te rekenikai, ma nanoaana bon te oota ao te nanoanga. Ienikuriiko nako iai bwa ko aonga n riki bwa te oota ae akea tokina ao te tamnei ae e aki maamate. Aio Au kaetieti nakoim, an ira nanona.
entries.label: Arabic HW 51

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 52
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Ngkana e bwakariko te tabomoa, tai kukurei, ao ngkana e roko iroum te tekebuaka, tai nanokaawaki, bwa ni kauoua a na taonnako ao a na akea.
entries.label: Arabic HW 52

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 53
entries.text:
O NATIN AE MAIU!

Ngkana e roko te maiu ni kainnano iroum, tai nanokaawaki; bwa ni waakinakon te tai Uean te kaubwai e na kawariko. Tai maaka te kamaemaeaki, bwa n te bong teuana ao te mimitong e na tiku iroum.
entries.label: Arabic HW 53

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 54
entries.text:
O NATIN AE E MAIU!

Ngkana ko katurua nanom iaon te tautaeka ae e rietaata ae akea tokina ao n aki kona ni maamate, ao te maiu ae Mangkoangkoa, ao n aki tootoki, katuka taekan te tautaeka ni uea aio ae e maamate ao ae e kai mauna nako.
entries.label: Arabic HW 54

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 55
entries.text:
O NATIN AE E MAIU!

Tai katabeaiangako ma te aonaba aio, bwa n te ai Ti kataa te koraa, ao ma te koora Ti kataiia Ara toro.
entries.label: Arabic HW 55

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 56
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Ko tangiria ni kan karekea te koora ao I tangiria bwa ko na inaomata mai iai. Ko taku bwa ko kaubwai ngke ko bwaibwai iai, ao I kina kaubwaim ngkana ko kaitiakiko mai iai. Ni Maiu! Aio Au atatai, ao anne bon am iango ni katautau; e na kangaa Kawaiu ni bootau ma kawaim?
entries.label: Arabic HW 56

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 57
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Anga Kaubwaiu nakoia Au kainnano, bwa i karawa ko na kona ni kareerekei man taian bwariko aika a uauatao aika aki tae raitiitiia ao taian kaubwai ni mimitong aika a aki kona ni mamate. aika a aki mamauna mimitongiia i karawa. Ni Maiu! N angarake tamneim bon te bwai ae e rangi ni mimitong riki ke arona bwa ko kona n nooria ni Matau.
entries.label: Arabic HW 57

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 58
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Te tembora iroun te aomata bon Au kaintokanuea; kaitiakia man bwaai nako, bwa ikanne Nna kabobonga Nneu ao ikanne Nna mamaeka iai.
entries.label: Arabic HW 58

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 59
entries.text:
O NATIN AE E MAIU!

Nanom bon Mweengau; katabua ibukin Ruou. Tamneim bon Au tabo ni kaotioti; kaitiakia i bukin Kaotiotau.
entries.label: Arabic HW 59

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 60
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Karina baim i nanon Bwanibwaniu, bwa I aonga ni kona n rierake i aom, n raneanea ao n raitiiti n ota nako.
entries.label: Arabic HW 60

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 61
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Rierake nakon Au karawa, bwa ko aonga iai ni karekea kukurein te manga kaaitibo, ao man mwangkon te mimitong ae e aki maamate nima ni kakorakoraa te wain ae akea n ai arona.
entries.label: Arabic HW 61

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 62
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

A mwaiti boong aika a tia n riaom ma ko katabeko ma am iango aika akea nanoia ao katautau aika akea uaaia. Maanra riki am tai ni matuu iaon am kainiwene? Tabeka atuum man matuum, bwa e a tia ni otirake Taai nakon katokin rietana, ni kukurei ni kaotako ma otan te tamaroa.
entries.label: Arabic HW 62

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 63
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

E a tia te ota n otanako i aom man oraitanin te Maunga ae e tabu ao tamnein te kaotaaki e a tia n ikeike inanon Tiinain nanom. Ma ngaia are, kamwaawako man rabunanimatan taian iango aika akea aaia ao rinnako inanon oon Au katawanang, tei i Matau, bwa ko aonga n tau nakon te maiu ae akea tokina ao n tau ni kaaitibo ma Ngai. N aron aei ao te mate e na aki roko iroum, ke te kua ke te kanganga.
entries.label: Arabic HW 63

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 64
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Au aki-tootoki bon Au karikibwai, I a tia ni karikia ibukim. Karekea bwa kunnikain am tembora. Au katiteuana bon Au karaobwai; I a tia ni karaoia ibukim; kunnikainiko iai, bwa ko aonga n riki n aki tootoki bwa kaotiotan Arou ae akea tokina.
entries.label: Arabic HW 64

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 65
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Kakannatou bon Au bwaintangira nakoim, ao Rietaatau bon kanikinaean Au nanoanga nakoim. Te bwai are e tau Ibukiu akea ae e na mataata iai, ke ni kona n taekinna temanna. Ni koaua, I a tia ni kaawakinna i nanon Batau ao i nanon kaubwain Au kaetieti nako, bwa kanikinaean Au tangira n akoi nakoia Au toro ao Au nanoanga nakoia Au aomata.
entries.label: Arabic HW 65

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 66
entries.text:
O NATIN TE OI N TAMNEI AE AKEA RABWATANA!

Ane kam na tuukaki man Tangirakiu ao tamnei a na aki rau ngkai a tabe ni Mwaneweai. Bwa iango a aki kona ni mataata Irou ke naano ni kona ni Kamaekaai.
entries.label: Arabic HW 66

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 67
entries.text:
O NATIN TE TAMAROA!

N Tamneiu ao n Au Akoi! N Au Nanoanga ao n Tamaroau! Bwaai nikabane ake I a tia ni kaotii nakoim ma newen te korakora, ao n tia ni koreia ibukim ma kainikorobokin te mwaaka, a bon tia ni kaineti nakon am konabwai ao mataatam, tiaki nakon Aroarou ao n tangin Bwanaau.
entries.label: Arabic HW 67

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 68
entries.text:
O NATIIA AOMATA!

Kam aki ata bukina ngke Ti kariki ngkami nikabane man te tano ae ti te arona? Bwa akea ae e na karietaata riki iaon temanna. Karaua n iangoia n taai nako i nanomi bwa kam kanga ni karikaki. Ngkai Ti a tia ni kariki ngkami nikabane man ti te aekana te tano kam kabaeaki bwa kam na riki bwa ti teuana te tamnei, n nakonako ni waemi aika titebo, n amwarake ni wiimi ae titebo ao ni maeka n te aba ae ti te arona, bwa mai kabin nanomi, man ami beku ao ami mwakuri, kanikinaean te katiteuanaaki ao oin kamwawaan bwaai e na kaotaaki. Aio Au taeka n reirei nakoim, O kaain te runga n ota! Ongotaeka nakon au reirei bwa ko aonga ni karekea uaana ae e tabu man kain te mimitong ae e kamiimi.
entries.label: Arabic HW 68

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 69
entries.text:
O NGKAMI NATIN TE TAMNEI!

Bon nnen Au kaubwai ngkami, bwa i nanomi I a tia ni nnei momiin Au kamiimi ao atiibu aika a kakaawaki man Au ataibwai. Kamanoi mai irouia ianena i buakoia Au toro ao mai irouia naake aki onimakina Te Atua i buakoia Au botannaomata.
entries.label: Arabic HW 69

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 70
entries.text:
O NATIN TEUARE E TEI IRARIKIIA AKE BON AEKAKINA INANON ABANUEAN ARE BON NGAIA!

Ataia ngkoe, bwa I a tia ni kakiaa nakoim boiararan nako te katabuaki, I a tia ni kaotii n tabwaniniia nakoim Au taeka, I a tia ni kakororaoia rinanom Au kakabwaia ao I a tia n tangiria ibukim te bwai are I a tia n rineia bon Ibukiu. An rauaki ngkanne ma are I kukurei iai ao anga am kakaaitau Nakoiu.
entries.label: Arabic HW 70

entries.name: Arabic Hidden Word 71
entries.text:
O NATIN TE AOMATA!

Korei bwaai nikabane ake Ti a tia ni kaotii nakoim ma ingken te ota iaon buatuan tamneim. Ngkana e aki mena aio inanon korakoram, ao karaoa ngkanne am ingke bwa oin nanom. Ngkana aio ko aki kona ni karaoia, ao an koroboki n te ingke are e uraura are e a tia ni waanako inanon Kawaiu. Ni koaua, e karewerewe riki aio Irou nakon bwaai nikabane, bwa e aonga otana n teimatoa n aki toki.
entries.label: Arabic HW 71

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 1 - NATIN TE TAMNEI O! Au moa n reirei bon aei: Bwaina te nano ae e itiaki, n aakoi ma n oota, bwa e aonga n riki Ueam ae mangkoa, ae e teimatoa n aki tootoki. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 1

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 4 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! I tangira am karikibwai, ai ngaia are I karikiko. I bukin aei, ko na Tangirai, bwa I aonga n ingoaniko ao ni kaona tamneim n te tamnei ni kamaiu. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 4

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 6 - NATIN AE MAIU O! Am Bwaretaiti bon Au tangira; mwengam i karawa, bon manga okim Nakoiu. Riin iai ao tai baenikai. Bon aei te baere e a tia ni katauaki i bukim i nanon Ara abanuea i eta ao Ara tautaeka ae rietaata. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 6

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 7 - O NATIN TE AONAABA! Ngkana ko Tangirai, ao kaakea arom i bon iroum; ao ngkana ko ukoukora Kukureiu, tai tabe ni mwannanoa nanom; bwa ko aonga ni mate Irou ao I aonga ni maiu ma ngkoe n te maiu ae akea tokina. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 7

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 8 - NATIN TE TAMNEI O! Bon akea te rau iroum ma ti ngkana ko kaakiko ao ko rairaki nakoiu; bwa e riai i bukim bwa ko na mimitong i nanon Arau, tiaki i nanon aram; ni kawenea am onimaki Irou ao tiaki i nanom, kioina ngke I tangiria bwa Nna tangiraki n ti Ngai ao I aon bwaai nako. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 8

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 9 - NATIN AE MAIU O! Au tangira bon Au nono; are e rin iai e mano ao n rau, ao are e tannako mai iai i koaua e na bon bua ao ni mate. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 9

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 10 - NATIN TE TAEKA O! Bon Ngkoe Au nono; riin iai bwa ko aonga n tiku n rau. Ataia, bwa are i nanom Au tangira, bwa ko aonga ni Kuneai ni kaan nakoim. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 10

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 11 - NATIN AE MAIU O! Bon ngkoe Au taura ao Ootau ane iroum. Karekea ootam mai iai ao tai ukoukora riki temanna i Rarikiu. Bwa I a tia ni karikiko ni kaubwai ao I a tia ni karaanga nako aom Au bwaintituaraoi. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 11

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 12 - NATIN AE MAIU O! I karaoiko ni mwaakan Baiu ao ni korakoran Tabonibaiu I karikiko; ao I a tia ni kawenea oin Ootau i nanom. Rauaki iai ao tai manga ukeaaba, bwa Au mwakuri e kororaoi ao e kabaebae au kaetieti. Tai titiraki bukina, ke ko nanokokoraki iai. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 12

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 14 - NATIN TE TAMNEI O! Bon au tautaeka ngkoe ao Au tautaeka e aki mamauna, e aera ngkai ko maaka maunam? Bon Ootau ngkoe ao Ootau e aki mamate, e aera ngkai ko maaka te mate? Bon Mimitongiu ngkoe ao Mimitongiu e aki raarai; bon Au kamwarai ngkoe ao Au kamwarai e aki kona ni mane. Tiiku ngkanne n am tangira i Bukiu, bwa ko aonga ni Kuneai i nanon te abanuea ni mimitong. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 14

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 15 - NATIN TE TAEKA O! Raira matam Nakoiu ao kaaki taekan bwaai nako bwa ti Ngai; bwa Au tautaeka e teimatoa ao Ueau e aki mamauna. Ngkana ko ukoukora temanna riki i Rarikiu, eng, ngkana ko teteimatoa ni ukeaaba te uniweeti, am ukeuke e na bon aki uaana. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 15

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 16 - NATIN TE OOTA O! Mwaninga bwaai nako ma bon ti Ngai ao matanria ma Tamneiu. Bon aio raoi oin Au tua, mangaia are rairaki nako iai. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 16

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 17 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Rauaki Irou ao n aki ukoukora te tia ibuobuoki riki temanna. Bwa akea bwa bon ti Ngai ae e kona n tau i bukim. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 17

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 18 - NATIN TE TAMNEI O! Tai butiai te baere Ti aki kaantaninga i bukim, an rauaki naba n are Ti a tia ni motikia i bukin arom, bwa bon ngaia te bwai ae e na raka iai arom, ngkana ko karauakiko iai Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 18

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 21 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! I aon te kai ae e raneanea n te mimitong I a tia ni katinei i bukin uaa ni kai ake a bane rinoaia, ao e aera ngke ko a tannako mai iai ao ko a katabeko ma ake a aki bati n raraoi? Ooki rikaaki ngkanne nakon are e tamaroa riki i bukim i nanon te abanuea are i eta. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 21

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 22 - NATIN TE TAMNEI! I a tia ni karikiko n toronaomata, e ngae n anne ko a kamangoriko. Teirake ngkanne nakon are ko karikaki i bukina. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 22

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 23 - NATIN AE RIETAATA O! I weteiko nakon ae akea tokina, e ngae n anne ko ukoukora are e kakai mauna. Tera ae e katannakoko man Ara kaantaninga ao ko ukoukora ae bon nanom? Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 23

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 24 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Tai riaon are katauam, ke ni kan bwaina are e aki tau i bukim. Aroriko i matan Atuam, Uean te mwaaka ao te korakora. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 24

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 25 - NATIN TE TAMNEI O! Tai kamoamoako i aon te kainnano, bwa I kairiiria i aon kawaina ao I nooriko i nanon kangangan am kaairua ao I kabooa baam n aki toki. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 25

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 26 - NATIN AE MAIU O! Ko kanga ni kona ni mwaninga am kaairua ao ko katabeko ma aia kaairua tabeman? Ane e kakaraoa aei e na kamaraiaki Irou. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 26

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 28 - NATIN TE TAMNEI O! Ko na ataia bwa te koaua; Bwa are e a kairiia aomata nakon ae eti ao ngaia bon boton te buaakaka bon tiaki Mairou, e ngae ngke e uota Arau. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 28

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 29 - NATIN AE MAIU O! Tai kabuakaka temanna n te baere ko bon aki kan kabuakakaaki iai, ao tai tataekina te baere ko aki kan kakaraoia. Aio Au tua nakoim, an ira nanona ngkoe. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 29

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 30 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Tai rawa iroun Au toro ngkana e Butiiko te bwai teuana, bwa moamoana bon Moau; ko na maama i Matau. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 30

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 31 - NATIN AE MAIU O! Tau mwiin aroaron n te bong ae koraki i mwaain teweam nakon te kaitira; bwa e na roko te mate, ni kakubako, ao ko na weteaki bwa ko na kaotaa bukin nako am mwakuri. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 31

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 33 - NATIN TE TAMNEI O! Ma rongorongon te oota ae e kakukurei i butimwaiko ma n taku: Kimwareirei! I kaooko nako matan ae e tabu: tiiku i nanona bwa ko aonga ni maeka i nanon te rau n aki toki. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 33

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 34 - NATIN TE TAMNEI O! Tamnein ae tabu e uota nakoim te rongorongo ae kakukurei i bukin te manga katiteuanaaki; e aera ngkai ko nanokaawaki? Tamnein te korakora e kateimatoako i nanon Ana waaki; e aera ngkai ko a karabako? Ootan Moamoana e kaririko; ko kangara n tibanako? Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 34

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 35 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Tai kananokaawakiko bwa ti ngkana ko raroa nako Mairoura. Tai kimwareirei ti ngkana ko a roko ni kaan n Okiriira. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 35

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 36 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Kimwareirei i nanon kukurein nanom, bwa ko aonga n tau ni kaitibo ma Ngai ao ni kaotaa nako Tamaroau. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 36

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 37 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Tai buuta mai i aom Au kamwarai ae e tamaroa, ao tai tuuka tibwangam man Au koburake n ran ae e kamiimi, bwa ko rawa n ae ko a bon taataka nako naba. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 37

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 38 - NATIN AE MAIU O! Nakonako n Au tua i bukin Tangirau ao tuukiko man tangiran te baere ko tangiria ngkana ko ukoukora Kakukureiau. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 38

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 39 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Tai kaaki Au tua ngkana ko tangira Tamaroau, ao tai mwaninga Au reirei ngkana ko kan karekea Kukureiu. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 39

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 40 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! E ngae ngke ko kabutimwaakako n ri buakon buburakaein te tibeiti ao n tia naba ni kabuta rababan karawa, e na bon aki reke naba motirawam bwa ti n te Ongotaeka nakon ara tua ao te nanorinano i Matara. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 40

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 41 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Katanoataa Au Waaki bwa I aonga ni kaota nakoim kamimiin Kakannatou ao ni kaotaa nako aom te oota ae akea tokina. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 41

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 42 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Kamangoriko i Matau, bwa I aonga ni kataua kawaram. Teirake i bukin kanakoraoan Au Waaki, ngkai ko bon mena i aon te aba bwa e na kona n reke iroun te tokanikai. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 42

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 43 - NATIN AE MAIU O! Mwaneweai i aon Au aonaaba, bwa I aonga n Uringko i nanon Au karawa, bwa aonga ni karauaki Matau ma matam. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 43

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 44 - O NATIN TE KAINTOKANUEA! Kakauongom bon au kakauongo, kakauongo ngkanne iai. Noraabam bon Au noraaba, taratara ngkanne iai, bwa i nanon kabin tamneim ko na kona ni kakoaua rietaatan Arou ae tabu, ao Ngai i Nanou Nna kona te kakoauaa rietaatan te karinan i bukim. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 44

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 45 - NATIN AE MAIU O! Kataua te mate ni maritire ni Kawaiu, rauaki n Au kukurei ao n rangi ni karabwarabwa i bukin are I a tia ni baaireia, bwa are ko aonga iai ni motirawa ma Ngai i aan taubukin te kakannato i akuun te umwanrianna ae e mimitong. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 45

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 46 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Iangoia ao katautaua. Bon nanom bwa ko na mate i aon am kainiwene, ke ni katuua raraam i aontano, ni maritire i nanon kawaiu, ao n riki bwa te tia kaotioti i bukin Au tua ao te tia katereterea Au oota i nanon te Baretaiti ae kabanean te rietaata? Motika nanom raoi, ngkoe te toro! Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 46

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 47 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! N raoiroiu! Kabiran iran atuum n raraam e rangi ni kakannato i Matau nakon karikan bwain karawa nako ao te oota i bukin aonaaba aika uoua. Kekeiaki ngkanne bwa ko aonga ni karekea aei, ngkoe te toro! Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 47

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 48 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! I bukin bwaai ni kabane bon iai te kanikina. Kanikinaean te tangira bon te ninikoria i aan Au moti ao te taotaonakinnano i aan Au kataitai. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 48

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 49 - NATIN TE AOMATAO! Te tia tangira ni koaua e ingainga nanona i bukin te kanganga n ai aron ae e karaoia te tia aki ongeaaba i bukin kabwaraan ana bure ao te tia burerawawata i bukin nanoangaeak Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 49

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 52 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Ngkana e bwakariko te tekeraoi tai kukurei, ao ngkana e tokariko te tekebuaka, tai bwaebwaeti, bwa ni kauoua a na mauna nako ao a na akea riki. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 52

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 53 - NATIN AE MAIU O! Ngkana e roko te kainnano iroum, tai nanokaawaki; bwa ane e na roko iroum n te taina Uean te kaubwai. Tai maaka te mangori, bwa te mimitong ane e na wene i aom n te bong teuana. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 53

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 54 - NATIN AE MAIU O! Ngkana mamaten nanom te tautaeka ae akea moana ma tokina, aei, ao te maiu aei are mangkoa ao akea tokina, an biritana te tautaeka ae e maamate ao ae e kakai mauna nako. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 54

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 55 - NATIN AE MAIU O! Tai katabeaiangako ma te aonaaba aio, bwa n te ai Ti kataa te koraa, ao ma te koora Ti kataiia Ara toro. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 55

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 56 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Ko tatangira te koora ao I tangira inaomatam mai iai. Ko taku bwa ko a rangi ni kaubwai n rekena iroum, ao I kina kaubwaim ao katabuam mai iai. Ni maiu! Bon aio Au rabakau, ao anne bon am katautau; e na kangaa ni bootau Kawaiu ma kawaim? Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 56

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 57 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Anga nako aoia au kainnano Au kaubwai, bwa ko aonga ni karekei man titoa aika aki tae tamaroaia ao kaubwaia aika a aki mamauna mimitongiia i karawa. Bwa ni Maiu! Te angarake tamneim bon te bwai ae mimitong riki ti ngkana ko kona n nooria ni Matau. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 57

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 58 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Te tembora n rabwata bon Au kaintokanuea; kaitiakia man bwaai nako, bwa I aonga n teimatoa iai ao I aonga ni mamaeka iai. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 58

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 59 - NATIN AE MAIU! Nanom bon Mweengau; katabua i bukin Ruou. Tamneim bon Au tabo ni kaotioti; kaitiakia i bukin Kaotiotau. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 59

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 60 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Karina baim i nanon Bwanibwaniu, bwa I aonga ni kona n rierake i aom, n raneanea ao n raitiiti n oota. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 60

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 62 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! A mwaiti boong aika a tia n riaom ma ko katabeko ma am iango ake ko bon taku ao katautau aika akea uaaia. Maanra riki am tai ni matuu i aon am kai ni wene? Tabeka atuum man mwanioniom, bwa e a tawanou taai, tao e na kaootako ma ootan te tamaroa. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 62

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 63 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! E a tia oti i aom am oraitanin te Maunga ae tabu ao te tamnei ni kaotaota e a tia n ikeike i nanon Tiinain nanom. Mangaia are, kamwaawako man katautau ma iango aika akea maneia ao kaaraki tei i Matau, bwa ko aonga n tau nakon te maiu ae akea tokina ao n taubobonga raoi ni kaaitibo ma Ngai. N aron aei e na aki kona n roko iroum te mate, ke te kua ma te kanganga. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 63

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 64 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Au aki-tootoki bon Au karikibwai, I a tia ni karikia i bukim. Karekea bwa niiran am tembora. Au katiteuana bon Au arinibai. I a tia ni karaoia i bukim; kunikaiko iai, bwa ko aonga n riki n aki tootoki bwa te tia kaotiota Arou ae akea tokina. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 64

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 65 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Kakannatou bon Au bwaintangira nakoim, ao Rietaatau bon kaotan Au atataiaomata nakoim. Bwa te baere e tau i Bukiu akea ae e na ataia, ke ni kona n taekinna temanna. I a bon tia ni kaawakinna i nanon Batau ake a raba ao i nanon bwaron Au kaetieti, bwa kanikinaean Au moamoaaomata nakoia Au toro ao Au atataiaomata nakoia Au aomata. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 65

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 66 - ATAEIN TE OI N TAMNEI AE AKEA RABWATANA O! Ane kam na tuukaki man Tangirakiu ao tamnei a na aki rau nanoia ngkai a karaoa mwaneweakiu. Bwa iango a aki kona n Raweai ke naano ni kona ni Kamaekaai. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 66

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 67 - NATIN TE TAMAROA O! N Tamneiu ao n Au bwai n akoi! N Au atataiaomata ao n Tamaroau! Bwaai ni kabane ake I a tia ni kaotia nakoim n te newe ae e korakora, ao n tia ni koreia i bukim n te kai ni koroboki ae e mwaaka, a bon katauaki nakon konabwaim, tiaki n Aroarou ao n tangin Bwanaau. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 67

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 68 - NATIIA AOMATA O! Kam aki ata bukina ngke Ti kariki ngkami ni kabane man te tano ae ti te arona? Bwa akea ae e na karietaata iaon temanna. Karaua n iangoia n taai nako i nanom bwa e kangara aron karikami. Ao ngkai Ti a tia ni kariki ngkami ni kabane man te tano ae ti te aekana e riai iroumi bwa kam na riki n ai aron te tamnei ae ti teuana, bwa kam na nakonako ni waae aika ti taboo, n amwarake n ti tewiina ao ni maeka n te aba ae ti te abana, bwa are man kabin nanomi, man aroaromi ao n ami beku bwa aonga ni kaoti kanikinaean te katiteuanaaki ao oin kamwawaan bwaai. Bon anne Au reirei bwa kam aonga ni karekea uaana ae e tabu man kain te mimitong ae e kamiimi. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 68

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 70 - NATIN TEUARE E TEI I BON BUKINA I NANON OIN ABANUEANA O! Ko na ataia, bwa I a tia ni ikenna nakoim boiararan nako te katabuaki, I a tia ni kaoti raoi nakoim Au taeka ni kabane, I a tia ni katamaroai rinanom Au kakabwaia ao I a tia n rineia i bukim are I a tia n rineia i bon Bukiu. An rauaki n Nanou ao ni kaaitau Nakoiu. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 70

entries.name: Kalimat-i-Maknunih (Hidden Words - Arabic)
entries.text: - 71 - NATIN TE AOMATA O! Korei ni kabane ake Ti a tia ni kaotioti nakoim ni kanan te kai ni koroboki ae e oota i aon buatuan tamneim. Ngkana akea ni korakoram, ao karaoa ngkanne kanan am kai ni koroboki ma oin nanom. Ngkana ko aki kona ni karaoa naba aei, ao ani koroboki ni kanan te kai ni koroboki ae toka uraurana are e a tia ni kabwaroaki i nanon Kawaiu. E karewe riki aei Irou nakon bwaai ni kabane, bwa e aonga n oota ootana n aki toki. Bahá’u’lláh
entries.label: Arabic HW 71
